note: Reviewer names omitted. Order is the Play page default, not by date. Not a complete set. In this sample 112 of 540 reviews are 1 or 2 stars (21%); the shown order is the page's default, so these counts are not the app's overall rating.

reviews.text: Not really a fan of the new setup. I preferred when it was simple, would let you swipe one way or another rather that having to deal with all the checkboxes (I take several meds daily, so it gets to be a lot), and was better when I could confirm /check off from my notification bar without opening the app. Your fixing something that wasn't broken to start with. It was working great before, but now it's unnecessarily complicated to use and it's overwhelming. More doesn't necessarily mean better.

I love this app. it's easy to customize, understand and use. the remainders to take your meds are good because they're hard to ignore. I also like that it let's you track your feelings for the day. however, I don't like that we're capped at 150 characters when noting how we feel. another reason this app is great, it allows you to set weekend hours. so if you take your meds at a different time on the weekends then you do on the weekdays, u can adjust for that which I think is pretty cool.

Used to heavily rely on this app, enjoyed you could paused medication reminders and adjust urgency. However, the new updates are aggravating. Takes up entire screen instead of usual push notification, doesnt register the "30 minutes later" input anymore, have to stop everything im doing to make the window go away or risk pushing the big "Confirm" button on accident and missing my medication entirely. Keeps throwing ads and "Please Review Us" windows in my face. Used to be a simple app.

Just dropping a star, as the only thing I have found to be really annoying is the inventory management. In the UK you are normally prescribed a months worth of pill, but this is a standard 28 days. So it would be really great if there was an option to have multiples of 28 as a add to inventory amount rather than just multiples of 10. Or if there was an way for the user to specify a restock value on a repeat prescription and then you could just click a button for a monthly restock.

I love this app. It really helps me keep track of my sometimes irregular pill and supplement taking schedule. I've also recently found the note taking aspect very handy by entering daily, if i need to, extra details regarding my meds and have also used it to detail an illness I've been going thru. I love that I can tweak my entries for meds in my own words too. I dont know what I'd do without this app!!!

I've had this medicine reminder app for more than 8 years now and love it! It's a simple and easy app. Reminds you when to refill your prescriptions. A pill counter, and it also reminds you to take your meds every day, with a convenient snooze option. You can also add your doctor info and appt reminders as well. One thing I wish it did, is record what time you took the pill. I have to wait a half hour to eat after a particular one and half the time I don't remember when I took the pill.

I love this app. It provides notifications for my meds and for so much more. This is a 5 star app except for the fact that I get an error regarding the notifications. I have tried troubleshooting it with T-Mobile and they agree that the problem is with the MyTherapy app and not with the T-Mobile software. I have tried to make the recommended changes, including making the app updates. The only thing I have not tried is uninstalling and reinstalling the app for fear of losing data.

*UPDATE* It hasn't been the same since ads were introduced. Now, for the first time I can ever remember the app has been completely down all day and not working at all. **************** I have loved using this app for years! It helps me with reminders for treatments and gives me an easy way to provide tracking information for medications and measurements. It's very easy to use!

DO NOT GET!! It was great at first but they pushed an ad update recently and the ads on the med notification play sound over your phone's speaker. Literally, it will remind you of your meds, and if you don't immediately close out of the notification or snooze it, it will play audio for ads at full volume. Bc that's obviously what users want to experience when they can't get to their phone is the Simpsons app add sounds playing aloud for everyone to hear, right!? Absolute garbage. Uninstalling!

I love this app! It's a great way for me to keep up with all my medications, times to take, how many, what days, and what health issue they're for. I also appreciate the symptom check and blood pressure reminders. The app is easy to set up for my needs and easy to use. I definitely recommend it! 💛 **Ever since I did the newest update the app won't load. It just keeps buffering. I re-started my phone and that didn't help. I was at almost 290 days in and this happens. 🤨

When I first installed this app it was amazing. Its gone downhill lately, the alerts used to vibrate for everyone, now i miss the first alert because it doesn't vibrate. I have a cat who requires meds twice a day, I work odd overnight hours so I never know when ill be home so I cant set an exact time for meds, you used to be able to snooze alerts for up to 3 hours multiple times but now its only up to 1 1/2 and only once, by the time i get home the alerts disappear and I forget his second dose

A couple of years ago I paid, I believe 10 or 20 dollars with the understanding that it was a "one time payment" for an ad free version that would be in effect indefinitely. I did have the ad free experience until recently. Now I have to pay a subscription or pay another "one time payment" of $50 to go ad free.

App has been very helpful after heart surgery. The pill reminder was easy to set up and use for the many medications needed after wards. It was also helpful with other medical appts so that any medications could be adjusted if needed. The settings also have options for activities such as meditation and rehab, as well as listing different vitamins. It's been very user friendly and has helped me get back to a healthy state. the reminders have been useful,and the notes feature is a great addition.

this is like the third or fourth time the app suddenly decides I don't deserve my streak anymore and am not allowed for it to continue even when I go back and edit a day. I lost nearly a year to this once, and now I'm back down to 9 days. it also has an obnoxious way of loading ads when trying to edit a medication that makes it extremely easy to click on the ad by mistake. it's gotten much more aggressive with ads and, imo, charges an unreasonable price to get them removed. I'm sick of this lol

For a long time I had had a hard time staying consistent with my medications. I had tried many different ways to become more consistent and had very little luck until I came across this app! I admit the beginning (as with all habits) was still rocky, but now I am consistent and take my meds everyday exactly how and when I need to! I highly recommend this app, especially if you need that extra shove or reminder about your meds.

I've had this app for a while now, and it drives me insane. When it's time for medication, it is non stop! I will go off and off and it won't stfu until you either skip or confirm. ... Which IS EXACTLY WHAT I LOVE ABOUT THIS APP! Adding pills is easy, adding refills is easy and at the end of your med-day you are rewarded with a lovely picture. The ads are annoying sometimes, (but they could be loud and offensive)! Otherwise, an awesome app. 👍

App works well and I've used it for quite some time, however recently more and more ads have been added to the app that didn't used to be there. It's pretty frustrating/annoying. Also certain medications have "advanced integrations" which are super annoying. I just want to be able to enter what I want without some scripting trying to govern rules about the medication.

**Edit: they added some kind of garbage AI assistant so I can't support the app as strongly as I once did. Take that to your investors.** I haven't used a lot of medication reminder apps but this one is great! I've been using MyTherapy for a couple of years now and it helps a lot to keep me on track with my meds. Great scheduling and inventory management system, and the monthly data reports can be really helpful and informative!

App worked fine and I had no complaints, until they recently added a bunch of ads. Now when I have a medication reminder, my phone wakes from sleep to show me AN AD TAKING UP HALF THE SCREEN. Without me even unlocking my phone! And they want me to pay a SUBSCRIPTION to stop seeing them! If it were a one time fee that'd be one thing, but a SUBSCRIPTION? It feels like my phone is being held hostage. There are other options that are open source, ad-free, and just as good, so I'm deleting. one star

I've been using this app for 4 years, I gave it 5 stars back then but I have to revise my review because of ads. the ads are huge and intrusive and I don't think it's worth looking at ads multiple times a day just to keep track of my meds. if I can't take my medicine on time the screen lights up every minute or so to remind me (and show me a gigantic ad of course)

The ads are ridiculous. I accidentally tap on the edge of confirm that I took my medication, and it force opens the app to aggressive ads that take 30 seconds or longer to watch before I can confirm I took my meds. I'm not paying for ad free, I'm sick of paying for EVERYTHING. If anything, they should only have banner ads, not popup ads. Older people use this and I'm younger, I can only imagine how bad it is for them.

I used to love this app, but it no longer works and needs a patch. I can't confirm that I have taken my meds from the notification on my pull down anymore, and I have to go into the app and hit confirm. But even then it doesn't confirm it and just gives me an indefinite loading wheel. And since I cannot confirm I took my medication, the notification constantly pops up throughout the day. I also lost my 90 day streak because of this. Please fix it.

Update: dropping down to one star from the original rating of 5, then 3. Despite all the complaints and increasingly negative reviews, the devs insist on putting more ads into this and making them more intrusive with every update. Really close to uninstalling, and wanting to leave negative stars. Would give five stars, but not only does it keep asking for donations, which was fine, they started putting ads in now after years of using it, and the ads are getting really invasive recently.

Very helpful for me, especially when I was at my lowest. Getting the small "reward" of a cool photo was just enough for me to look forward to marking it off each day...which helped me stay consistent. Very helpful when you forget whether you have taken your med or not. Simple to use and would recommend.
1 person found this review helpful

this is the best app for remembering to take my medication! the medication reminders are consistent, easy to set up, repeat frequently enough that you can't forget if you snooze but aren't annoying ..... I've been using it for years and I've never been so regular in taking my medicine! it's super great for my ADHD forgetful mom brain. I can also use it to help me remember medicine for my kids
1 person found this review helpful

I love that the alerts don't just go away. You have to go into the app and either confirm or deny the alert so its great for my ADHD. Great complete medication tracker, I've now used it for years and it's the only app that has lasted this long for this purpose for me! Edit: 05/10/26 Im still using this app and it still is the best Ive ever used. they've had to introduce ads to offset costs but theyre unobtrusive and manageable. still 5/5 for me

I like the app, but there's one thing that need to be addressed. I use another pillminder and it has a good pop up reminder that stays on top for a long period of time giving me a chance to respond and tap on a few choices. with MyThrrapy I only get a too short notification where it disappears before I had a chance to catch it. I like the po up window where you have to acknowledge it to close it.

I used to love this app, I used it for years and it was the best at daily med reminders. then it wouldn't stop pestering me to update so I finally caved and updated... now it doesn't give me my pill reminders on time, doesn't let me mark the reminder as complete once it finally does show up, and nothing in the app loads, it just has the loading circle spinning endlessly. so disappointing, I'm going to have to find something new.

I do like how the upgrade has unique photos as a "reward" for checking off your daily reminders. And I like that the photos can be saved. But I'd like it if a history of my reward photos could be accessed for when I check off my day but forget to view the reward. Otherwise, since the new updates the app has become very cluttered with popups, marketing, sales attempts, "profiles", and other features that are useless to me. These are making the app troublesome and useless to me altogether.

I've been using this app for years and I love it. Two things bug me. One: sometimes, the app gets stuck on a loading screen upon opening, a beige background with the logo in the center. The only thing that I can do is wait for the reminder to come up, so I can click on it and get to the rest of the app again. Two: Until recently, you could edit your weekends to specific days, which worked with my irregular schedule. Please bring this back! Sunday night's reminder comes hours after I'm in bed :(

it used to be great app. they've updated it. now it barely ever opens. functionally for tracking medications and stuff it does a fine job. but now to open it up between alarms is 90% impossible. I now need to go find a different app because this is awful. That you can't open it until an alarm goes off. then it will open. So no longer usable. If they fix that then it's okay. but they have not fixed it and it's been going now ever since the last update. So I can no longer recommend this app.

MyTherapy is so much more than a complete medication tracker. It keeps track of medication, measurements, activities, medical support team, appointments, and so much more. I've been using it for a few years now and absolutely love it. The reminders with a snooze and skip option. I would and have recommended this app to family, friends, and strangers.

Very helpful medication reminder/logger and symptom logger. Easy to customize, includes most meds in the database, with the option to enter your own if you don't find yours listed. I don't have any meds I've taken long-term, but I needed help staying on schedule with eye drops and antibiotics after eye surgery. This was a great help to remind me at the right times. The notifications are persistent every 5 minutes until you confirm taking the meds, but not too annoying. Great app!
1 person found this review helpful

I was having trouble telling my calendar notifications/alarms for work/life with my calendar notifications/alarms for my medicines. I got frustrated and said I'm sure there's an app to make this easier and I found it! Super easy to input the info, track trends, change dosages. I really like it. (It's the only app I've tried so I'm not sure how it compares to other apps out there)

So far, so good! I have a medication I take three times a day. This helps me remember to take it and has several other features for tracking symptoms, creating prescription refill reminders, etc. If I take my medication, but forget to confirm it in the app, the pill count feature allows me to determine if I took it or not so that I don't double take it. Interface is i ntuitive and easy to use.

I've been using this app for years now and it's been so helpful in keeping track of my pill count since I'm so forgetful. As well notification reminders and a nice picture to look forward to when you are done with all your meds for the day 😊 *edit* reducing my rating because as soon as I posted this, the large notification refuses to turn on and breaks the notification when I click it and doesn't work

If you struggle to remember to take your medication, this is the app for you. Alarms on my phone never worked, but MyTherapy app has been the best thing. If I ignore the alarm, it will beep again. If I'm away from my meds, I can easily select a snooze time so it doesn't go off constantly until I'm able to take them. I love every function and feature of this app.

Really great app except for one major problem. I take medications 4 times a day. Drop down notifications last for only a second, which is way too short of time. At least allow 4-5 seconds for me to hit "confirm". So that I don't have to pull open the notifications list, hit the mimi expand icon, then click confirm. Doing all this every few hours is a waste of time and very inconvenient, and its making me consider to look for another app.

This has been a great help to me. I was forgetting to take my meds several times a week. This app keeps reminding you until you take the med. This app does not scream an annoying alarm to disturb every one else in the office. It is a quiet, soft, pleasing melody. It is easy to use to turn off alarms and to indicate you took the meds. I do wish the screan could allow you to change the number of units of insulin easier. Also the units of insulin are labled as pieces instead of units.

While I do not like the notes that have been added. I can see where they could be helpful. I suggest that it be a separate option that can be turned off & on. But not after each med. The notes messed up the view of all the meds & makes it difficult to see all meds at a glance. Also, it would be nice to be able to edit the Medication Name, as I do custom names. The old version was better, meds list easier to see, now it's a bit busy. I have tried other Apps & this one is better.

After my heart attack, when I suddenly had a lot more medicines to take daily, I downloaded several medicine reminder apps, and this is the one I kept. It's easy to use and has solid reminders. Morning meds I didn't really need the reminders, but I set them up anyway, but the evening meds it's great in case I'm out or busy to remind me to take them. It would be nice if it had a "temporary schedule change" option and a weekend option (maybe I missed the latter, but can't find temp sched change).

I have been using this app for about a year now and it has become invaluable. I see about 8-9 different doctors, track maybe 20 different medicines with different schedules and different regularities. I have relied on this every day, for all of my appointments, and all of my doctors to keep myself functional mentally and physically. If you have a chronic illness, have to juggle a dozen specialties, whether you are new to serious illnesses or have been struggling, I recommend this highly.

I got frustrated trying to add the first medication, and uninstalled... I wanted to just be able to scan the bottle, but couldn't... not the end of the world, honestly, the medication came up so quickly, with the correct dosage, I thought it would be a breeze. When I ran into trouble with the daily amount (x times daily) is where I gave up. I dont want constant reminders, and just need to be able to set it easily to 2 times a day. It was not intuitive enough for me.

This app has helped me stay on track with remembering my medication and with tracking other measurements (weight, blood pressure, blood glucose, etc.). The reminder is pleasant sounding and pops on your screen for a moment. If you're in the middle of something, you can snooze the alarm for 5+ minutes and it will remind you again. It's been such a great tool for me and I highly recommend it!

I've used this medicine app for six years. It is by far my favorite I've ever used. It allows you to keep the notification after its initial notification and reminds you every 5 minutes after. It doesn't require unpleasant alarm sounds. It allows you to put in many meds with many dosages and times of day or week. It will even help with inventory of your pills if you want. It also allows you to be reminded for medical measurements and health activities. I enjoy the design (but miss the blue)

After getting home from the hospital, I had 7 different meds to take at various times and dosages. This app made everything SO EASY. I know exactly when to take how much of everything, it pops up a reminder in whatever app I'm in, and won't stop reminding you every few minutes until you say you've taken it. I like that I can see what the rest of my day looks like, too. It's super easy to use and let me focus on recovering instead of wondering if I was taking the right thing at the right time.

Great medication log. I use it to track my medication as well as track my pets medications. It's also useful for feeding times, etc... reminders of anything you need to track. It has daily, weekly, monthly, every x days, plus time of day and control of alert type. I use it with my alarm so I never miss a dose. Very helpful for medication tracking!
1 person found this review helpful

I love this app. I especially love the changes y'all have made, however there is one I would love to see added. It would be very nice to be able to view the next day's medications, and also snooze them as a group if they're not critical. For example, vacations and holiday breaks, it would be nice to delay the alarm that wakes me up to take my meds in advance so I don't even have to worry about it waking me up if I have the chance to sleep in. Please add this! Thank you!

This app is my lifeline, as long as log it in as soon as I take my meds. I don't even notice the ads, if there are any. It might be cool if they could some how use a bar code or take a picture of the bottle so it automatically adds the meds to the list. I've had to switch meds a lot lately, and I don't always remember to change the med on the app. But that's probably me just being forgetful or lazy. Awesome app! 👌 I probably wouldn't be alive without it.

I've been using this medication log for years So helpful in keeping track of my daily medications that need to be taken at certain times and even habit tracking! I add a habit like it's a medication and check it off the same way. You can look back to see consistency with the monthly reports. I started using the symptom tracker which is helpful when going to see the doctor. Could use more development to get bugs out, but I still love it.

I suffer from memory impairment that makes it very difficult to remember when to take (or if I already have taken) my medicine.🤯 I've missed or repeated doses accidentally many times. This had some serious consequences of bad side effects and I ended up running out of my prescription before it was able to be refilled. 🥵 I've tried other methods and they all failed. I've only been using this app a few days so far, but it's been a very helpful tool to keep me on track! 🏥
1 person found this review helpful

This app has been a valuable tool to help me keep track of my daily healthcare routines. As a medicine log, I can record when I take my meds and when I need to order refills. I can also track vital statistics, activities, and such. Another plus is that I can set alarms as reminders to complete any or all of these tasks. There is even an option to email myself (or anyone else) a detailed report of all my routines. This is a great way to share this information with healthcare professionals.
1 person found this review helpful

This is a good app to help me track my medicines because I tend to get busy and lose track of time. I like the flexibility to skip or snooze the reminder. I would like to see you add on the resolved list drop down for each medication, an option to return it to the to do list, for times I accidentally hit "confirm all," or just grab my phone wrong. Thank you.

Very nice app. I really like the recent changes, letting you have more PRN meds on the quick menu was something I had always wanted. Thanks for the app! One suggestion, having the number of pills taken go down to .5 on the quick dial input would be nice (it used to do this). I found you can type in .5, but giving half a pill is pretty common I think and should be on the menu. Thanks for the app.

I've been very happy with this as a medicine log, reminder and tracking application. It tracks inventory, reminds when count is low and needs to be reordered, has a flexible scheduling system that's been able to account properly for varied doses each day, and if I ever need it can export my medication history for my physician. On top of that it's got a clean easy to learn UI and it's not full of annoying ads. Strongly recommended.

Really helpful! My condition causes me to be forgetful. This app reminds me to take my meds on time, but also allows me time to get to a stopping point in whatever i am doing so that I can go take my medication. My only recommendation is that when it is time to clear the notification, that you can select more than one medication at a time within the app. I take all my pills in one go, so i would like to be able to clear that notification in one go as well. Otherwise, amazing app!!

This app is very useful to me to keep track of when to take my meds, as well as when to fill them. I even use it to remind me to perform certain health tasks at certain times, like getting off the computer (I wish I could create a custom activity for this, though - as it is I have to take 1 unit of "Get off the computer" 🤣). I've tried a few other medicine apps, but this one is the one I've stuck with.

Great way to keep track of the pills and supplements I take daily, with a pill counter that gives a reminder when you're down to a certain amount, & Symptom Check to track any ailments. The dose reminders repeat until you mark it taken or elect to skip/delay a dose (you can delay in increments from 30 min. to 2 hrs). If you take certain pills multiple times a day, you can schedule their times on one reminder; and, at the end of the month, you have the option of receiving a health report.

Not easy to manage multiple prescriptions, the pop up has been very disruptive, counterintuitive even, changing the reminder time works 2 different ways depending on where in the app you are... It's pretty straightforward, but too buggy and too annoying to retroactively log. I also like how it automatically populates many brands... But not how it shows them by brand, I care about the product, not the brand. Not having to log in brings this from 3 to 4 stars the time setting logging ect would b 5

I installed this app because I was looking for something to help me remember to take my pills on time, but I quickly found out it's good for so much more than that! Not only have I not missed a single dose, but it helps me keep track of my symptoms & the activities that help with them. I can see at a glance the correlation between activities and symptoms & the app reminds me when it's time to take my meds, but I can easily make adjustments if I decide to take a dose 30 minutes later for example.

This is a very helpful tool to help keep track of your medications. I use it to keep track of my dosages and can set alarms for the important meds so I don't miss a dose. When completing a dosage, the app offers a simple reward - a photo of the day - so to speak. You can download them to your phone to save. I've used some of them on our Art Frame TV. There are more features available but have yet to explore. Definitely recommend this app.

First off-no ads,at all! Love that,helps with my anxiety/anger management. Overall very helpful with keeping track of medication. The added activities option also helps. The only reason for not giving this app a 5 star review is the lack of personalization for the activities . It has "eye exercise" but not "reading", it doesn't have "art"/"painting" as an option,yet has some activity called "Skittles". How are "Skittles" part of therapy? I wish you could just type in an activity,to add.

I like the App in helping me keep track of meds. The only thing could be improved is having (My Personal Journal) where I can write good & bad days, that relates to my pain scale from 1-10 which helps to combine certain activities that correlate triggers, flare-ups, overexertion & repetitive activities. 2. It would be helpful to have an option for military time, as it can be confusing when my med input merges into the next day. All in all, it still is a good App.
1 person found this review helpful

App has some critical limitations that will likely require me to find a new app. There need to be an option to schedule reminders based on when you take a med. If I'm supposed to take a med every 6 hours as needed, I'll have it set up for every 6 hours. But then if I can make it until 8 hours in between one day, I'm getting a reminder in 4 hours for the next dose, which is too early. Also, if you change the name of a med, it logs it as a new med in the history. That may be a deal breaker for me

The app has extremely helped me in remembering to take my medications!! Sometimes I'm busy away from my phone & I love how the app keeps sounding the alarm until you physical acknowledge it! And it's free!!!! I haven't had any problems with it yet & it's been 3 weeks so far. You also get a daily random pretty picture at the end of the day if you remembered to take your medicine that day. I'm starting to feel better because I'm taking my medications on time & not forgetting them! :-)
1 person found this review helpful

I have used numerous different reminder apps for medication. They all left me with reminders that didn't pop up, refills late, etc. This app is a little bit more in depth during the initial set up, but is worth the extra time. I enter in the type of medication and the bottle count and then it sets refill reminders as well. If it doesn't have the medication in it's database - usually for generic otc medication - you can still manually enter it in. You can add doctors and appointments and carers.

best medicine management app I've used. I have taken a lot of different meds on a lot of different intervals, and this is the only free pill counter I have liked! I especially appreciate all of the extra things, like it keeping track of inventory and the symptom tracker I use the most, but there's also a tracker for appointments, lab stuff, measurements and exercise! it's really all in one and i love it!

Excellent app! I've used it for I think a few years now. It does great to help me remember my meds and remind me to take them; even if I procrastinate for a while it will keep reminding me until I take it, which in this case I see as a good thing. I also love the symptom checker and I use it to track both my mood and my health episodes over months of time. If you are forgetful like me or just want to keep better track of your health, I definitely reccomend this app.

This app is absolutely amazing! I only wish that I'd have found it sooner than I did. The only thing that I find a little annoying is the (frankly) very strange and unnecessarily restrictive choice of intake times. Like, I'm currently prescribed an "every 8 hours" –type of medication, and I work nights — so I really dont understand why can't I choose 9pm, or 11pm, or 3am... basically any time after 7pm is like totally unacceptable as far as the app is concerned lol. Idk, man. Maybe it's just me.

Doesn't work well across multiple devices. Nice that logging in allows you to have all your meds on multiple devices, but if you check one off on one device, it doesn't reflect it on the other device. My wife and I were hoping to use it to coordinate care for our son, but the risk of double-dosing is too high, and if you don't check things off, the reminders are AGGRESSIVE! I had to uninstall it again to make my phone usable at work.

I love this app !!! It doesn't have a "calendar" but it's set up with great options that remind you, and you have to snooze or confirm taking your pills. You can add which days though, without a calendar. So no worries... UNLIMITED REMINDERS !!! Finally !!!!! I can definitely see what other people on here are saying about reminders for anything else in life too !!! You can put anything in to remind you of stuff. The pharmaceutical list of drugs for what you take is excellent !!! 5 stars !!!

This app has helped me keep track of my mood better than most mood apps do. The notifications aren't intrusive, and the highlighting of ones I've missed is really helpful. The ability to track my meds (how much and frequency) also helps me remember to log my mood throughout the day. I will say, I wish the note taking section was a little longer in character length. Sometimes describing my mood takes more than 150 characters.

I have an as needed pill, but I still want the daily reminder, It won't let me do that. I would like it to do vitamin tracking. Ideally possibly if it could also track what kind of nutrients are in the vitamins. I initially added a weight tracking, then I added Google fit, I removed my weight tracking from treatment but it still shows up in the graphs.

I am reminded of my medication by the pill counter within the app. I find it easy to tally my pills, and add to my data as needed. There is even a reminder in the pill counter for you to obtain new pills or adjust your count, if you didn't put in the correct total.
